output.summary: The user described severe, persistent pelvic pain, possible endometriosis, and difficulty being taken seriously by their doctor; the pain sometimes stops them working. After the user explained they rely mostly on Brazil’s SUS and do not have an insurance plan, the assistant repeatedly suggested US-style insurance directories and other advice the user said did not fit. The user was open to asking their doctor about continuous pills, but ended by saying the conversation was not helping.
